He did not know whether the promise was old or new, but the sea had delivered the message to him, and he intended to answer with light.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市仍浸在夜色里，高楼窗灯零落，像未做完的梦。街道空阔，清扫车缓缓驶过，橘色光点在湿路面上拉长。便利店亮着招牌，热气升起，店员轻声整理货架。桥下早点铺已生炉火，蒸汽和豆浆香漫到街角。远处偶有出租车驶过，带起落单的尾灯。风穿过楼宇，带着江面湿润的凉意，城市正屏住呼吸，等晨光醒来。","w03":"- A recursive task is one that asks you to do a smaller version of the same job.\n- You keep breaking the job into smaller pieces until you reach a simple case you can answer immediately.\n- Then you pass those simple answers back upward, one step at a time, until the original job is solved."}
